description: Unreal Engine pixel streaming runtime — runs packaged UE projects and streams the rendered output. Runtime only, no editor.
notes:
Runtime only — this image contains no editor. Package your project in the Unreal Engine workspace, then mount or copy the packaged build into /{username}/unreal-packaged and launch it here.

Requires GPU agent (gpu_count >= 1) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the agent host.

IMPORTANT: ghcr.io/epicgames/unreal-engine is NOT anonymously pullable — the Kasm agent needs GHCR credentials for an EpicGames-linked account.

The base image is small (~0.5 GB) because it ships runtime dependencies only; your packaged project supplies the content.

This is an Epic image, not a Kasm image — it carries no KasmVNC layer, so it is intended for headless streaming rather than a browser desktop.

Temporary working Kasm fallback: KasmOS desktop while native Pixel Streaming image is not KasmVNC based.
